taxonomy.note: Accepted by current Kew/POWO; Texas is within the native state-level range.

evidence: Travis County — UT Plant Resources Center's Travis County Passifloraceae herbarium index includes two Passiflora incarnata specimens.
Williamson County — UT Plant Resources Center provides a detailed field-based county treatment of Passiflora incarnata.
Targeted searches did not establish a third exact project target-zone county from authoritative native-flora/specimen sources.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Only two exact target-zone counties are locked. Texas statewide nativity, cultivation history, or a wild-looking observation cannot substitute for a third county.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not count horticultural plantings, seed introductions, or broad eastern-Texas distribution as exact target-zone native evidence.

morphology.look_here_first: Check the petiole glands and leaf margin before the giant flower. Maypop has two conspicuous nectar glands on the petiole, large deeply 3-lobed leaves with serrated margins, and much broader lobes than birdwing passionflower. The huge corona flower and large maypop fruit then make confirmation easy.
diagnostic_traits: vigorous perennial climbing/trailing vine with annual above-ground stems and axillary tendrils
petiole with two conspicuous sessile extrafloral nectary glands
lobes broad, pointed and distinctly serrate
flower solitary and very large, commonly around 5–6 cm or more across
five sepals and five petals surround a showy multi-whorled purple/white corona
large ovoid to subglobose berry/maypop, green becoming pale yellow/orange-yellow when mature
fruit much larger than P. lutea or P. tenuiloba

confusers.separator: P. lutea has no petiole glands, entire broad-rounded lobes and tiny greenish flowers/berries. P. incarnata has paired petiole glands, serrate pointed lobes and huge flowers/fruits.
P. tenuiloba also has petiole glands but its leaf lobes are extremely narrow and entire; flowers are tiny, green and petal-less. P. incarnata has broad serrate lobes and a huge corona flower.

diagnostic_roles: petiole macro showing two nectar glands
photo_verification.provenance_note: Morphology package is usable now, but canonical native installation remains blocked until a third exact target-zone county is documented.
